summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market share repurchases as part of an existing buyback program. On 17 June 2026, it bought 5 million ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at volume-weighted average price of 105.0392 pence per share (range 103.95–105.80 pence). The program was announced on 30 January 2026; purchased shares will be cancelled. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory deadline is stated. This is a routine capital return via issuer tender, not a special-situation event. What to watch: execution pace and impact on EPS and capital ratios.
